name: Vox Paper Collage
description: An editorial explainer in hand-cut paper collage: torn edges, halftone, tape, newspaper scraps, maps with red dashed routes and bold cut-out headlines, one paper sheet sliding over the last on every beat. For history, how-it-works and why-it-matters explainers.

inputs.label: Soru başlığı
inputs.help: The first beat's headline: one bold word on red, the rest on cut strips

inputs.label: Bölümler
inputs.help: One headline per beat; a four-digit year becomes a ransom note

inputs.label: Anlatım
inputs.default: Kahve dünyayı nasıl ele geçirdi? Hikâye Etiyopya'da başlar, Yemen'de demlenir. Bin beş yüz elli dörtte İstanbul'da ilk kahvehaneler açılır. Oradan Avrupa'ya, sonra tüm dünyaya.
inputs.help: Spell numbers out for the voice; the captions keep the digits

inputs.label: Görsel tarifleri
inputs.help: Optional: the scene of each beat as separate cut-out pieces; empty lets the agent write them

voice.direction: A curious, warm documentary narrator, brisk but clear. Cut the beats on the narration's word timings.

music.prompt: light documentary underscore, curious and playful, pizzicato strings, marimba, soft percussion, steady pulse, instrumental, no vocals

credits.name: vox-director (look rules, prompt structure, keyframe motion)
